name: lockstep
description: Multi-package script and toolchain drift checker.

scripts.smoke: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js scan tests/fixtures/workspace --policy tests/fixtures/workspace/lockstep.config.json --format markdown --output /tmp/lockstep-smoke.md && test -s /tmp/lockstep-smoke.md
scripts.release:check: npm test && npm run check && npm run build && npm run smoke && npm run package:smoke

author: Roger Chappel
